project_type: Full-stack community platform - Go backend with React 19 SPA frontend
build_system: Makefile wrapping Go build + pnpm for frontend. SPA is embedded into Go binary.
test_framework: Go tests (go test ./...), Frontend: ESLint + TypeScript typecheck (pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck)
build_command: cd web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'pnpm typecheck' in web/ to verify frontend compiles. 2. Run 'pnpm lint' in web/ for lint checks. 3. Run 'go test ./...' from project root for backend tests.
setup_instructions: 1. cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. 2. Ensure Go is available for backend compilation.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access available. No running database for integration tests.
contribution_requirements: User-facing strings must support both en-US and zh-CN. Keep PRs focused. Include screenshots for UI changes.

key_patterns.backend_models: Models in internal/models/models.go with GORM tags. AutoMigrate handles schema changes.
key_patterns.backend_services: Services in internal/services/ as singletons (var XxxService = newXxxService()). Use repositories for DB access.
key_patterns.backend_handlers: API handlers in internal/handlers/api/ using Gin context. Response rendering in internal/handlers/render/.
key_patterns.backend_routing: Routes registered in internal/server/router.go using Gin groups
key_patterns.frontend_routes: File-based routing in web/app/routes/ using React Router 7 conventions
key_patterns.frontend_api: API client functions in web/lib/api/ using serverApiFetch wrapper
key_patterns.frontend_types: TypeScript interfaces in web/lib/api/types.ts matching backend resp structs
key_patterns.frontend_i18n: Translation messages in web/lib/i18n/messages/ (en-US.ts, zh-CN.ts). Used via useI18n() hook returning t() function
key_patterns.frontend_components: Reusable UI in web/components/ui/ (shadcn), domain components in web/components/{topic,layout,common,etc}
key_patterns.frontend_layout: MainShell component supports aside prop for sidebar layout
key_patterns.frontend_state: Client-side fetching pattern: useEffect + useState with API calls

directory_structure: Root: Go backend (main.go, internal/, cmd/, migrations/). web/: React SPA (app/routes/, components/, lib/). locales/: Backend i18n YAML. docker/: Docker configs.
